## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmation: only Energy, Healthcare and Consumer Staples showing 1W strength while 8 sectors are down, and leadership is broad (Top 5 across Tech, Energy, Consumer Stpl., Consumer Disc.). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare strong via UNH (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples via PM (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities lag: CEG (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary lagging with BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND and NKE-related weakness; Communication weak with CHTR (1W: -9.38% | 1M: -40.53%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CSCO (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) ABOVE TREND, F (1W: +10.14% | 1M: +9.07%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMD (1W: -6.83% | 1M: +52.41%) CORRECTION, EL (1W: -6.87% | 1M: +6.56%) CORRECTION, BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.11% | 1M: +0.74%) CORRECTION, SHOP (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -21.00%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select tech and discretionary names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: CSCO (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%) ABOVE TREND; market shows MAJOR divergence across large-cap names (several majors with 1W ≠ 1M) — watch for trend break and tactical opportunities.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: AAPL (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +14.09%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +0.39%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +13.60%) ABOVE TREND, but multiple large caps in CORRECTION (AMD (1W: -6.83% | 1M: +52.41%) CORRECTION, QCOM (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +49.84%) CORRECTION) — sector is internally mixed.

8. Financials Outlook?
Tepid-to-negative: V (1W: +2.40% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND but JPM (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -3.92%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -0.26% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND; Financials showing uneven internals and limited breadth.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Constructive but nuanced: UNH (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND, while PFE (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -5.41%) BELOW TREND — watch headline-driven moves and earnings/sentiment flow.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Given NEUTRAL regime and broad leadership with major divergences, favor exposure to Energy and select Healthcare and Consumer Staples names (XOM, UNH, PM) and reduce exposure to clearly BELOW TREND names in Communication and select high-multiple Tech/Discretionary; style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CSCO (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -21.00%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +6.66% | 1M: +5.82%) and Healthcare (1W: +0.70% | 1M: -2.24%) for continued relative strength. BEARISH: Utilities and Consumer Discretionary for volatility and downside risk given recent negative moves.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +13.60%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through above recent highs; AAPL (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +14.09%) ABOVE TREND as support reference for tech risk; XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND to confirm Energy leadership; BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND as downside trigger for discretionary weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
D (+90): NextEra-related utility M&A talk — cross-ref with sector weakness (Utilities down) so this is a divergence to monitor. CEG (+80): strong revenue and outlook headline but price BELOW TREND (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) — clear divergence. PFE (+75): hemophilia approval headline but price BELOW TREND (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -5.41%) — sentiment not yet confirmed by price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BKNG (-60): cut guidance and new debt headline confirming price BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%). UNH (-45): Berkshire exit headline but price remains ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) — notable divergence to monitor. EL (-40): negative headlines with price in CORRECTION (1W: -6.87% | 1M: +6.56%) confirming near-term weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership. XOM, UNH and CSCO showing relative strength (XOM ABOVE TREND, UNH ABOVE TREND, CSCO ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major divergence across large caps (many 1W vs 1M disagreements) and several sentiment/price divergences (CEG, PFE, UNH) — watch for confirmations.
